SELECT
        SUM("raw_wc_time") AS "Wall-Clock Time (core-hours)",
        SUM("raw_wc_work") AS "Wall-Clock Work (HS23 core-hours)",
        SUM("raw_cpu_time") AS "CPU Time (hours)",
        SUM("raw_cpu_work") AS "CPU Work (HS23 hours)",
        MEAN("raw_cpu_eff") AS "Mean CPU Efficiency"
    FROM "$influxdb_measurement"
    WHERE
        $timeFilter
        AND "infra" =~ /^$infra$/
        AND "benchmark" =~ /^$benchmark$/
        AND "vo" =~ /^$vo$/
        AND "tier" =~ /^$tier$/
        AND "country" =~ /^$country$/
        AND "federation" =~ /^$federation$/
        AND "ngi" =~ /^$ngi$/
        AND "site" =~ /^$site$/
GROUP BY
    "$groupby"
    fill(none)

SELECT
        SUM("job_count") AS "Number of Jobs"
    FROM "$influxdb_measurement"
    WHERE
        $timeFilter
        AND "infra" =~ /^$infra$/
        AND "benchmark" =~ /^$benchmark$/
        AND "vo" =~ /^$vo$/
        AND "tier" =~ /^$tier$/
        AND "country" =~ /^$country$/
        AND "federation" =~ /^$federation$/
        AND "ngi" =~ /^$ngi$/
        AND "site" =~ /^$site$/
GROUP BY
    "$groupby"
    fill(none)

SELECT
     SUM("memory_used") AS "Memory Used",
     SUM("disk_used") AS "Disk Used",
     SUM("vm_count") AS "Number of VMs",
     SUM("cpu_core_count") AS "Number of Cores",
     SUM("network_in") AS "Inbound Network Traffic",
     SUM("network_out") AS "Outbound Network Traffic"
    FROM "$influxdb_measurement"
    WHERE
        $timeFilter
        AND "infra" =~ /^$infra$/
        AND "benchmark" =~ /^$benchmark$/
        AND "vo" =~ /^$vo$/
        AND "tier" =~ /^$tier$/
        AND "country" =~ /^$country$/
        AND "federation" =~ /^$federation$/
        AND "ngi" =~ /^$ngi$/
        AND "site" =~ /^$site$/
GROUP BY
    "$groupby"
    fill(none)
